name: io.github.noahowsh/puckapi
title: PuckAPI
description: The hockey API for stats, odds, and everything between. REST API and MCP server. Free to start.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your PuckAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at puckapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: All 32 active NHL teams with divisions, conferences, and arenas

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games for next N days

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find players by name, team, or position

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Query by date, team, season, game state, or type

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Detailed stats for a specific team with advanced metrics

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Player bio and team context; season line for skaters, goalie stats for goalies

tools.name: get_goalie_stats
tools.description: Goalie leaderboard sorted by save%, GAA, GSAX, or wins

tools.name: get_skater_season_stats
tools.description: Skater leaderboard sorted by points, goals, assists, +/-, or shots

tools.name: get_player_game_log
tools.description: A player's game-by-game stat lines for a season, not a season total

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Odds by game with bookmaker filters

tools.name: get_game_detail
tools.description: Full game detail with odds and goalie starts

tools.name: get_plays
tools.description: Play-by-play events with rink coordinates, strength state, and the players involved

tools.name: get_shot_map
tools.description: Every shot attempt with rink coordinates, shot type, shooter and goalie
